{{Top}}
[[File:LightsaberTrainingDroid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], practicing [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber technique]] with a training droid.]]
'''Training droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used for training and honing various skills, such as [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] or marksmanship. The hazards that training droids incurred widely varied. Some, such as the [[Marksman-H combat remote|Marksman-H]], delivered harmless shocks to the trainee; others, such as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[ASP-19 battle droid/Legends|dueling droids]], could kill an ill-prepared trainee.

In a military context, if training droids were equipped with higher-power weapons, they could be employed on the battlefield. Moreover, training droids used for marksmen to practice quick-draw skills, reaction times and accuracy.

In [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], the use of training droids developed the [[Form I/Legends|Shii-Cho]] combat form. Furthermore, the droids recorded the actions of two combatants in training and measured their vital constants. Other training droids were equipped with lightsabers instead of light blasters. Training droids were also used in [[Sith training]], with [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] such as [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and Darth Vader using them to hone their lightsaber skills.
